title: Kentucky Revised Statutes Chapter 337 - Wages and Hours
verified_how: Fetched the KRS chapter index at apps.legislature.ky.gov/law/statutes/, which prints the entry '337 WAGES AND HOURS', and then the chapter page itself (chapter.aspx?id=38890): live sections include .020 Time of payment of wages, .055 Payment of all wages upon dismissal or leaving, .060 Unlawful withholding of wages, .070 Employer wage deduction statements, .275 Minimum wage, .285 Overtime compensation, .385 Employer liability for unpaid wages, with the 1974/1978-repealed sections shown as repealed. Page states 'Includes enactments through the 2026 Regular Session' and 'The KRS database was last updated on 09/22/2026'.
notes: Minimum wage, overtime, wage statements, deductions and the wage-claim remedy are all in this chapter.
